name: generate_docstrings_for_file
docstring: Generate docstrings for a specific file in the repo.

name: get_repo_analytics
docstring:
Returns doc coverage %, staleness breakdown, and symbol counts
    for the Analytics dashboard panel.

name: generate_architecture_doc
docstring: Generate architecture documentation from parsed files.

name: generate_api_documentation
docstring: Generate API documentation from router/endpoint symbols.

name: generate_engineering_docs
docstring:
Generate engineering documentation.
    body.doc_subtype: 'runbook' | 'onboarding'

name: get_generated_doc
docstring: Generic getter for any saved documentation by type.

name: StyleReferenceRequest
docstring: Attach a reference doc so the LLM mirrors its structure and tone.

name: _build_context
docstring: Build context dict from parsed files for prompt interpolation.

name: _interpolate
docstring: Replace {variable} placeholders with actual values.

name: validate_prompt
docstring: Run safety and quality checks on a prompt.

name: list_templates
docstring: Return all built-in prompt templates.

name: validate_prompt_endpoint
docstring: Validate a prompt for safety and quality issues.

name: preview_with_prompt
docstring:
Generate a preview with a custom prompt without saving.
    Returns the generated content and metadata.

name: generate_and_save
docstring:
Generate documentation with a custom prompt and save to DB.
    Optionally creates a GitHub PR with the generated content.

name: save_style_reference
docstring:
Persist a style reference for a (repo, doc_type) pair.
    Every subsequent generation for that doc_type will mirror the reference's
    structure, headings, tone, and formatting.

name: get_style_reference
docstring: Return the saved style reference for a (repo, doc_type) pair, if any.

name: delete_style_reference
docstring: Remove a saved style reference.

name: generate_with_reference
docstring:
Generate documentation that mirrors a provided reference doc's structure/tone.
    The reference is used as a *format template only* — all content comes from the
    actual codebase context.

name: get_edit_history
docstring: Return the last 20 edits for a given doc type.

name: create_pr_endpoint
docstring: Create a GitHub PR with the given documentation content.

name: _create_github_pr
docstring:
Push documentation to a SINGLE persistent branch ('autoscribe/docs').
    Creates the branch once; subsequent calls just update the file on that
    same branch and upsert (or reuse) the open PR.

name: get_current_user
docstring: Resolve the GitHub access token in the Authorization header to a DB user.

name: parse_owner_repo
docstring:
Accept any of:
      - https://github.com/owner/repo
      - github.com/owner/repo
      - owner/repo
    Returns (owner, repo_name).

name: fetch_github_repo
docstring: Call the GitHub API and return the repo JSON.

name: index_repository
docstring:
Embed all parsed symbols for a repo into ChromaDB.
    Must have parsed the repo first.

name: index_stats
docstring: Return whether this repo is indexed and how many symbols.

name: semantic_search
docstring:
Search indexed symbols by natural language query.
    Returns ranked results with similarity scores.

name: ask_question
docstring:
RAG-powered Q&A. Ask any question about the codebase.
    Retrieves relevant symbols, then uses Groq to answer.

name: check_staleness
docstring:
Check if documentation is stale (code changed but docs haven't been updated).
    Returns a detailed report of all stale files.

name: trigger_incremental_update
docstring:
Trigger incremental documentation update.
    Only regenerates docs for changed files.
    
    Body:
    - update_type: "docstrings" | "readme" | "all"
    - file_paths: optional list of specific files to update (auto-detects if omitted)
    - force_full: optional bool to force full regeneration

name: verify_webhook_signature
docstring: Verify GitHub webhook HMAC signature.

name: handle_github_webhook
docstring:
Handle incoming GitHub webhook events.
    Triggers incremental doc updates when code is pushed.

name: trigger_background_update
docstring: Background task — opens its own DB session (request session is closed by this point).

name: trigger_pr_comment
docstring: Background task — post a doc-summary comment on the PR (placeholder).

name: configure_webhook
docstring:
Configure GitHub webhook for a repository.

    Body:
    - enabled: bool
    - auto_regenerate: bool
    - webhook_secret: str (for HMAC verification)

name: get_webhook_status
docstring: Get webhook configuration status for a repository.

name: _style_block
docstring:
Build the style-reference section that gets prepended to any prompt.
    Keeps the reference trimmed to avoid blowing the context window.

name: _load_style_reference
docstring:
Load a saved style reference from the DB for (repo_id, doc_type).
    Returns the raw reference text, or None if not set.
    Silently swallows errors so a missing reference never breaks generation.

name: generate_readme
docstring:
Generate a full README.md from parsed file structure.
    Pass style_reference (raw text) to force a specific format.
    Pass repo_id to auto-load any saved style reference from the DB.

name: generate_file_docstrings
docstring: Generate docstring suggestions for all symbols in a file.

name: _generate_doc_type
docstring: Generate a specific documentation type from parsed file structure.

name: fetch_repo_tree
docstring: Return flat list of all blobs in the repo tree from GitHub API.

name: fetch_repo_files
docstring:
Download all parseable source files from a GitHub repo into dest/.
    Returns list of local Paths written.

name: incremental_update_docstrings
docstring:
Update docstrings only for changed files.
    If file_paths is None, updates all stale files.

name: incremental_update_readme
docstring:
Update README intelligently:
    - If major changes detected, regenerate full README
    - If minor changes, update only affected sections

name: _get_node_name
docstring: Extract the identifier name from a node.

name: _extract_docstring_python
docstring: For Python, grab the first string literal in the body as docstring.

name: parse_file
parse_repo
docstring:
Walk a local repo directory and parse every supported file.
    Returns a list of:
      { "file_path": str, "language": str, "symbols": [...] }
    Skips node_modules, .git, __pycache__, venv, dist, build.

name: index_repo
docstring:
Embed all symbols and save a faiss index for this repo.
    Overwrites any existing index.
    Returns number of symbols indexed.

name: search_repo
docstring:
Search indexed symbols by natural language query.
    Returns results sorted best-first with a cosine similarity score.

name: rag_query
docstring:
RAG-powered Q&A:
    1. Retrieve top-k relevant symbols via semantic search.
    2. Build a context block from names/docstrings/file paths.
    3. Ask Groq to answer the question given that context.

    Returns { "answer": str, "sources": [result, ...] }

name: get_index_stats
docstring: Return whether this repo is indexed and how many symbols.

name: _load_style_reference
docstring:
Load a saved style reference for (repo_id, doc_type) directly from an
    already-open DB session. Returns the raw reference text or None.
    Silently swallows errors so a missing reference never breaks generation.

name: _ensure_branch
docstring: Create AUTOSCRIBE_BRANCH if it doesn't exist. Returns True on success.

name: _commit_file
docstring: Upsert a file on AUTOSCRIBE_BRANCH. Returns True on success.

name: _upsert_pr
docstring: Open a PR from AUTOSCRIBE_BRANCH if none exists yet; otherwise leave it open.

name: _update_repo
docstring: Run a full autonomous doc update cycle for one repository.

name: _run_all_repos
docstring: Scheduled job: iterate every tracked repo with auto_regenerate=True.

name: start_scheduler
docstring: Start the background scheduler. Call once at app startup.

name: stop_scheduler
docstring: Stop the scheduler. Called on app shutdown.

name: calculate_file_hash
docstring: Calculate SHA256 hash of file content.

name: create_snapshot
docstring: Create a snapshot of a file at the time of documentation.

name: detect_stale_files
docstring:
Detect files where code has changed but docs haven't been updated.
    Returns list of stale files with details.

name: _compare_symbols
docstring:
Compare two symbol lists and return changes if any.
    Returns None if identical, or dict with added/removed/modified symbols.

name: get_staleness_report
docstring: Generate a comprehensive staleness report for a repository.

name: FileSnapshot
docstring:
Tracks the state of each file at the time documentation was generated.
    Used to detect staleness when code changes but docs haven't been updated.

name: WebhookConfig
docstring: GitHub webhook configuration for auto-triggering doc updates on push.

name: analyze_repository
docstring: Placeholder task — AST parsing & doc generation wired in Sprint 2+.
